findings.problem: [JUDGEMENT] Keyframe and clip-edge positions have only inspector number fields as non-drag route, and D8 gives number fields keyboard stepping and no pointer stepper, so a pointer-only user depends on an on-screen keyboard. The local WCAG 'single pointer' definition neither includes nor excludes typed entry; Understanding 2.5.7 is not among the local copies and network access was not permitted, so it is not cited either way. The earlier recheck treated a typed field as sufficient (its splitter remedy), so this is not raised to major.
findings.fix: Add 'Move to playhead' for keyframes and clip edges (the playhead is already placed by a click on the ruler), or a pointer stepper on these fields.

findings.problem: Pending click-placed states have no stated pointer cancel except the lasso: after the first Select area click or after choosing Place splitter, no Cancel command is named. NATIVE-MATERIAAL ends drag/modifier interaction on focus cancellation and lets a new focus generation inherit no held action; D9 does not say whether these pending states end there.
findings.fix: Name one Cancel route for every pending click mode (Select area, Place splitter, Polygon lasso) and state that focus cancellation ends them while keeping the selection.

findings.where: D9 line 168 versus the enumerated routes
findings.problem: The binding first sentence covers every drag, but named routes exist only for keyframes, clip edges, guides, layer/track order, splitters, docking, marquee/lasso and sliders. Moving a whole clip along or between tracks, canvas object move/resize/rotate, canvas pan and bin-to-timeline drag-and-drop have no named route for S7.
findings.fix: Add one sentence naming routes, e.g. inspector position fields plus Move to track, Insert at playhead, and scrollbar or navigator clicks.
